variants.title: 以真实首图为基准的内容条件
variants.changed: Only native source content latent conditioning is rebased to the native target-image anchor; static depth/mask remain identical to baseline.
variants.note_zh: 仅改变内容条件：以本例真实首图编码为基准，保留完整源视频相对初始时刻的编码变化；静态深度和遮罩与基线不变。这是实验性条件处理，不是物理3D动作标定。

variants.title: 恢复随动作变化的目标深度
variants.changed: Only depth/mask change from repeated endpoint geometry to historical native source-projected dynamic depth/mask at fixed nominal right30 target. Native content latent remains original.
variants.target_pose_calibration: nominal right30; actual ReCam pose not calibrated
variants.note_zh: 仅改变几何条件：使用源动作在固定数值约30°目标机位投影的动态深度和遮罩；完整视频与原生内容编码不变。该机位尚未与ReCam真实末帧标定一致。
